# Kenney Particle Pack

Downloaded 2026-09-09 from the author's official site:
https://kenney.nl/assets/particle-pack

Archive: https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/particle-pack/f8fe0f8cb8-1677578741/kenney_particle-pack.zip

License: CC0. Original `License.txt` is included. 80 transparent PNG source textures are available here; only referenced textures enter the world build. Unity imports them at a maximum of 256 pixels with mipmaps. No executable code was imported from this pack.

The scene's particle systems, controls, shaders, diamond shapes and confetti shapes were authored for Astra's Infinite Pole.

Template research: https://vcc.docs.vrchat.com/guides/using-project-template-repos/
This project already uses the installed official VRChat World template. Its SDK/ClientSim foundation is retained. A second environment template is unnecessary for the pole-and-void layout.
